sources.title: WhatsApp Help Center - How to use click to chat
sources.confidence_note: Full page body did not render through the available fetch tool (returned truncated); content corroborated via search-engine snippet extraction and a secondary Meta for Developers page rather than a full primary-page capture.
claims: The click-to-chat link format is https://wa.me/<number>
<number> must be full international format: country code + local number, no leading +, no leading zeros, no spaces/dashes/brackets
Meta's newer short-link system (wa.me/message/<code>) embeds the pre-filled message server-side and can mask the phone number, as an alternative to the classic wa.me/<number>?text=<message> pattern

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group - Trustworthy Design: 4 Credibility Factors
claims: Four credibility factors: design quality, upfront disclosure, comprehensive/correct/current content, connection to the rest of the web
Login/registration walls placed before any value is shown damage trust
For service-booking sites, showing real process photos (not just idealized end results) helps users assess who they are dealing with
Users trust independent/external validation (reviews, third-party mentions) more than company-sponsored content

sources.title: Smashing Magazine - Best Practices For Mobile Form Design
claims: Use semantic input types (tel, email, date, number, datetime, month) to trigger correct mobile keyboards
Minimum touch target 48x48dp with 8dp minimum spacing between adjacent interactive elements
Single-column forms complete 15.4 seconds faster than multi-column; only pair short logically-related fields on one row
Inline validation (on blur or ~500-1000ms pause) outperforms submit-only validation: 22% higher success rate, 42% faster completion, 47% fewer eye fixations
